overview:
The top 2 teams remain unchanged from last week. A TOTW performance from leaders Try hard FC meant they were able to slightly increase their advantage, however a decent score for 2nd placed Under my Cucurella will keep the league leaders looking over their shoulder. In fact, the 2 highest scoring teams this week were the top 2 teams in the league.

Another good week for Change Name saw them pick up 70pts and move up one place into 3rd, displacing Yorkshire Lass UTD who slip down to 4th. PurpleReina remain in 5th place.

Captain choices proved important in GW25, with popular choices Haaland, João Pedro and Fernandes all scoring high this week. Those managers keeping faith with Haaland as captain were finally rewarded this week, as he notched a goal and an assist in their 2-1 win against Liverpool.

We're around the 2/3 mark of the season now and I think chips, injuries and general FPL fatigue are all going to play a big part in who succeeds and who fails as we enter the last part of the season. Remember to use your chips wisely over the coming game weeks 🃏
totwDescription: Try hard FC are this week's highest scoring team, with 82pts and pick up their 6th(!) TOTW award of the season. The biggest scores came from Captain Fernandes, Rogers and Mbeumo who all found the back of the net, as well as Crystal Palace defender Lacroix who kept a clean sheet and racked up 15 defensive contributions. Well done Matthew, you're really showing us all how it's done 👏🏻
sackedDescription: Doggers FC are the lowest scoring team this week, with 40pts. Paul will be particularly disappointed with Spurs Defender Romero after he conceded 2 goals and received a red card against Manchester United, scoring -3pts for the team. Captain Haaland was the only player in the team with a significant score this week, chipping in with a goal and an assist - all other players were unable to score more than 4pts. Hoping for a better performance next time Paul 🙏🏻

otherUpdates.title: 👌🏻 Player of the Week
otherUpdates.content: Cole Palmer (CHE 🔵 - £10.5m) is POTW for GW25 with 20pts after scoring a hat-trick in 38 minutes, including 2 penalties, in Chelsea's 3-1 win over Wolves. Palmer hasn't been in sparkling form this season, particularly when you consider his hefty price tag - he has 67pts to his name and this is the first time this season he has scored more than 10pts in one game. Despite this, he has a TSB% of 13.5% and is selected by 2 of the league teams - Pure Worship and Wards Wanderers.

otherUpdates.title: ⏭️ Next Gameweek
otherUpdates.content: The deadline for locking in teams, transfers and chips for GW26 is Tuesday 10th February at 6pm.
